title: Sign in
subtitle: Use the Discord account an admin added to the allowlist.
headline: Plans your team and your agents both read.
tagline: Boards, planning interviews, specs and decisions for every Surf project, in one place.
apiKeyHint: Agents connect with an API key instead. Create one under API keys after signing in.

rejected.sendToAdmin: Send this ID to an admin to get access.

errors.notOnAllowlist: That Discord account isn’t on the allowlist yet. Ask an admin to add it, then try again.
errors.cancelled: Discord sign-in was cancelled. Try again when you’re ready.
errors.restart: The sign-in took too long or was started in another tab. Please try again.
errors.noUserInfo: Discord didn’t send your account details. Please try again.
errors.generic: Sign-in failed. Please try again, or ask an admin if it keeps happening.

consent.title: Connect an app
consent.heading: {client} wants to use your roadmap
consent.body: It will act as you: read and change projects, systems, tasks, specs and decisions you can access, through the MCP tools.
consent.redirect: After you allow it, you return to {host}.
consent.revokeHint: You can disconnect it any time under API keys → Connected apps.
consent.invalid: This request is invalid or has expired. Start the connection again from your app.
